**DB — `store/db/postgres/postgres.go`**

The struct is `postgres.DB`, defined at line 16:

```16:19:/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/postgres.go
type DB struct {
	db      *sql.DB
	profile *profile.Profile
}
```

It satisfies the `store.Driver` interface — the constructor `NewDB` explicitly assigns `&DB{...}` to a `store.Driver` variable before returning it. The name is deliberately generic because each dialect package declares its own `DB` type; the MySQL and SQLite equivalents follow the same pattern in `store/db/mysql/` and `store/db/sqlite/`. The remaining files in `store/db/postgres/` (`memo.go`, `user.go`, etc.) hang the rest of the interface methods off this same struct.
